entities.summary: The University of Defence is a public university in Serbia. It was founded by the decree of the Government of Serbia in 2011, and consists of one faculty with the headquarters in Belgrade. University of Defence is a university in Europe, established in 2011-02-24. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
